customReplacement.reason: The product-defining blind A/B review has no matching generic block, and adding a runtime UI dependency solely for this plain-JS local experiment would weaken the stack.

contract.purpose: Turn one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately without forcing a joke.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Meme Lab turns one pasted comment or situation into a useful meme immediately.
contract.audience: The owner first, with a public playground for lightweight feedback.
contract.job: Paste one comment, see the best meme and up to two alternatives, then record whether the result landed.
contract.thesis: A crisp white working canvas with pale-blue navigation, mint and yellow state landmarks, restrained borders and the experiment visible immediately.
contract.system: Clean Canvas uses a lightweight workspace rail, compact full-width situation setup and equal A/B comparison panes; catalogue, sources and history remain secondary.
contract.signature: A best-match result with two restrained alternatives, separate fit and static-quality signals, and one-tap feedback.
contract.risk: Strength and image quality must remain subordinate to contextual relevance, while a 3,000-item collection stays searchable and calm.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner selected direction C, Clean Canvas, from the simpler light and colorful second round; the candidate relevance labeller extends that system.
